items.body:
<details open>

chat-peg-parser : clear current_tool when pending_tool_call is reset (#29942)

A TOOL_ID node that arrives after TOOL_CLOSE wrote through `current_tool`,
which still pointed into the just-destroyed `pending_tool_call` optional
(use-after-free, then a second free of the id buffer). Clear the pointer on
reset.

</details>
